title: Retailers take a targeted approach to seasonal hiring in preparation for historic holiday sales year
summary: Retailers are taking a targeted approach to seasonal hiring as holiday sales are projected to surpass $1 trillion. Learn how brands are staffing stores, warehouses, and fulfillment operations for peak demand.
body_markdown:
The seasonal hiring rush is in full swing as retail companies shore up for their busy period. According to the National Retail Federation’s latest forecast, holiday retail sales this year are expected to surpass $1 trillion for the first time ever.


Matt Wilkerson, director of national accounts at HireQuest, said distribution activity remains strong this year, particularly in e-commerce fulfillment, warehousing, transportation and third-party logistics operations.


“Employers still need access to additional labor during peak periods,” said Wilkerson. “But many are seeking partners that can provide workforce flexibility rather than maintaining excess headcount year-round.”
